name: Manuel Noriega
summary: Noriega ruled Panama through the Panama Defense Forces after taking command in 1983, without holding the presidency. He relied on military power, the Dignity Battalions and control of the press, annulled the May 1989 election, and framed his confrontation with the United States in nationalist terms. His own stated ideology is not recorded beyond these rhetorical and practical positions.

reviewHistory.rationale: He ruled personally from 1983 and after October 1989 declared himself 'maximum leader', bypassing elected bodies. This is his practice, not a stated view on gridlock.

notes: Later pass 2026-11-23. Replaced the Wikipedia citations with the reports it relies on (US State Department 1989 human-rights report, Human Rights Watch, the federal court opinion, AP report of the 1988 Senate testimony, Britannica). Searched the themes government, liberty, world, means and society; economy, culture, ecology and technology have no record. His own memoir and speeches are in notFound; most statements are null. Four earlier answers resting on words or on a record that does not settle the statement were nulled. The 15 December 1989 'state of war' was declared by the National Assembly at his instigation, and he named himself no ideology.
